---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a user-facing capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the user problem and who encounters it. Focus on the need rather than an implementation.

## Desired outcome

Describe what a successful result would let the user do.

## Example

Provide a small Markdown example, workflow, or mock-up when it makes the proposal clearer.

## Constraints and trade-offs

Note relevant privacy, offline, browser, accessibility, or compatibility constraints.

## Alternatives

Describe current workarounds or other approaches you considered.
